remarks: Beautiful gem in the heart of Old Greenwich! This charming 3 bedroom, 2 bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Brand new kitchen, baths and recessed lighting. The home features a formal dining room, a bright living room, and a cozy den/office. The renovated kitchen includes gas cooking and all stainless steel appliances. H/W floors throughout, and 2 parking spaces in addition to the garage in driveway. A full, dry basement provides excellent storage. Ideally located close to the train and just minutes from Old Greenwich Village, shops, restaurants and beach. Easy access to everything this desirable beach community has to offer. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy life in Old Greenwich!
